mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate relative to historical averages compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is less than 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index level above 240 (indicating cumulative inflation exceeding 140% since 1982-1984) signals persistent high inflation, prompting central bank tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 240, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is less than 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 45% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.5%), the labor market tightness accelerates corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is less than 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals robust labor market conditions, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS is rising, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is less than 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index below 100 (relative to 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing and mining output, signaling economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is less than 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and a quarterly GDP growth rate below 1.5% (GDPC1) indicates a severe demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to recession fears.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and GDPC1 below 1.5% fails to predict negative returns in more than 45% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), the Federal Reserve's interest rate hikes increase the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, reducing valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0, or the Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows is less than 0.02.
